EcucPartition of the Pdu is given via Pdu.EcucPduDefaultPartitionRef or
Pdu.EcucPduDedicatedPartition.EcucPduDedicatedPartitionRef, where
EcucPduDedicatedPartition applies for Com configuration. Those relationships
are illustrated in figure 7.14. The reason not to define a dedicated EcuC configuration
structure for this purpose, is the assumption that the same tools are used to derive the
Com configuration for an Application Software Cluster and a Host Soft-
ware Cluster.
Those relationships are illustrated in figure 7.14.
